It also describes 3DSS as a 'surface rendering model' where 'per-layer opacity arises directly from the accumulated EWA reconstruction weight' and 'Surfel are oriented, opaque surface samples.' This supports the claim that volumetric representations are less preferred for physically-based inverse rendering (geometry/material recovery) and that the described method uses simple opacity (derived from coverage/weight) rather than learnable volumetric opacity.
